mechanism: Efavirenz induces CYP450 enzymes (particularly CYP3A4), potentially reducing ampicillin levels, though ampicillin is primarily renally eliminated and not significantly metabolized by CYP450.
action: Monitor clinical efficacy of ampicillin; standard dosing is typically adequate as ampicillin is not significantly CYP-metabolized, but consider therapeutic drug monitoring if treatment failure occurs.
